title: USING CONTEXT-DEPENDENT EMBEDDING TO DERIVE FUNDAMENTAL SENTIMENTS AND EXPAND THE SCOPE OF AFFECT CONTROL THEORY
reasoning: The paper focuses on using BERT (a transformer-based model) to estimate affective meanings within the framework of Affect Control Theory (ACT). While ACT involves an 'Evaluation' dimension (good vs. bad) and refers to 'morality facts' in social perception, the study's primary purpose is methodological lexicon expansion rather than evaluating or benchmarking religious, moral, or ethical reasoning.
